rationale: Lyc qualitative likely on ⲭⲱⲗⲕ̄/ϫⲱⲗⲕ̄ 'draw, set in array, bind' (cf. accumulated vocab ⲭⲱⲗⲕ̄). The 3sg.f form ⲥ-ⲭⲁⲗⲝ̄ 'she is drawn' pairs with ⲥⲧⲏⲕ ⲁⲣⲉⲧⲟ̄ 'she stands fast' as parallel statives describing the soul's bound-yet-standing state in cosmic captivity. Confidence moderate.

Lyc qualitative form of obscure root, possibly ϩⲱⲛ 'approach' or an emphatic particle. In context with ϩⲧⲏⲕ ⲁⲣⲉⲧϥ̄ 'he stands fast,' a positional/proximate sense fits. Confidence low; flagged for parallels.

Possibly Lyc reduction of ⲑⲃⲃⲓⲟ 'humble, bring low' (cf. accumulated ⲑⲃⲓⲟ) or a distinct verb of mistreatment. Listed in a quartet of violences inflicted on the soul (afflict/abuse/tear/eat). Confidence low.
Possibly Lyc reflex of ⲡⲱϫⲝ/ⲡⲱⲕⲥ 'tear apart, rend.' Member of a violence-quartet against the soul; circumstantial ⲉⲩⲃⲁⲭⲝ̄ ⲙ̄ⲙⲁⲥ 'tearing her.' Confidence low; flag for parallels.
Lyc orthographic variant of ⲃⲱⲗ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ 'release, dissolve' (already in glossary as soteriological terminology). The form ⲃⲱⲧⲉ for ⲃⲱⲗ may reflect a dialectal feature; meaning identical.
Lyc variant of ⲙⲣ̄ⲣⲉ/ⲙⲣⲡⲉ 'bond, fetter' (cf. accumulated ⲙⲣⲡⲉ). The eschatological bond/fetter in which the enemy is finally bound. Article ⲧ- with feminine grammatical gender.
Lyc form, possibly reflex of ⲱϣⲙ̄ 'be afflicted' substantivized as 'grief, affliction.' In the construction ⲃⲓ ⲁϩⲣⲏⲓ̈ ⲟⲉ̄ϣⲙⲕ̄ ⲁⲡⲟⲩϩⲏⲧ = 'they bear up grief upon their heart.' Confidence moderate.

Lyc compound ⲧ-ⲟⲩ-ϩⲉ = 'the their-manner' — possessive substantive of ϩⲉ 'manner, way' with 3pl possessor. Used in line 26 in the formula ⲣ̄ ⲧⲟⲩϩⲉ 'be in their condition,' marking the holy ones' eschatological restoration to their primordial state.
Lyc form on ⲙ̄ⲧⲁⲛ/ⲙ̄ⲧⲟⲛ 'rest' with prefixed ϩ-. In line 18 'ⲉϩⲙⲁⲧⲛⲉ ⲛϩⲏⲧ ϩⲛ ⲟⲩⲭⲣⲏⲙⲁ' = 'his heart at rest in a wealth' — the enemy's complacent ease in stolen property.

proposed_english: be in their condition / abide in their state
rationale: Verbal idiom: ⲣ̄- ('be, do') + ⲧⲟⲩϩⲉ ('their manner'). Eschatological-restorative formula for the souls' return to their original cosmic condition.
